content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Visva Bharati Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026 is Research Assistant. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant post in Visva Bharati Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000 per month for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Post Graduation in Social Science discipline (Physical Education) with 55% marks, along with NET, M.Phil./Ph.D.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the location of the Visva Bharati recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Visva Bharati located in Santiniketan, West Bengal, with the pincode 731235.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview.
